# Edifier

> Edifier is a premium audio brand offering high-performance speakers, headphones, and wireless audio equipment with award-winning design and Hi-Res Audio certification.

Edifier specializes in active speakers, wireless headphones, and audio accessories for both professional and consumer markets. The site features interactive product comparisons, detailed specifications, and a comprehensive product catalog spanning speakers, headphones, and accessories.

## Key Topics

- Active Speakers
- Wireless Headphones
- Bluetooth Audio
- Hi-Res Audio
- Noise-Cancelling
- HDMI eARC
- DSP Technology
- Speaker Models (M60, MR3, MR4, S880DB MKII)
- Headphone Models (WH950NB Gen2, W820NB Plus v25, G5BT CAT)
- Audio Codecs (LDAC, SBC)
- Edifier ConneX App
- Subwoofers
- Speaker Stands
- Audio Equipment
- Product Comparison Tools

## Product Catalog & Collections

- [All Products](https://us.edifier.com/collections/all-products): Complete product collection catalog for all Edifier speakers and audio equipment
- [Products](https://us.edifier.com/collections/all): Complete product catalog featuring speakers, active speakers, and hi-res audio equipment
- [Speakers Collection](https://us.edifier.com/collections/speaker): Edifier speaker collection featuring M60, MF200, R1280T and other speaker models
- [Headphones Collection](https://us.edifier.com/collections/headphones): Edifier headphones collection including wireless, noise-cancelling, and gaming headsets
- [Accessories Collection](https://us.edifier.com/collections/accessories): Edifier accessories including speaker stands ST200, ST300, and AirPulse stands

## Featured Products

- [S880DB MKII](https://us.edifier.com/products/s880db-mkii): S880DB MKII active hi-fi speaker product page with Bluetooth 5.3 and Hi-Res Audio specs
- [T5s Subwoofer](https://us.edifier.com/products/t5s-subwoofer): T5s active subwoofer product page featuring 8" woofer and Class-D amplifier
- [M90 Compact Active Speaker](https://us.edifier.com/pages/m90-compact-active-speaker-launching): Product launch page for M90 compact active speaker with HDMI eARC and DSP

## Product Comparison Tools

- [Speakers Comparison](https://us.edifier.com/pages/compare-products): Interactive comparison tool for Edifier speaker models including MR3, MR4, MR5, MP230
- [Headphones Comparison](https://us.edifier.com/pages/headphones-comparison): Feature comparison tool for Edifier headphones including WH950NB Gen2, W820NB Plus v25, G5BT CAT
